newsitem.title: USA: Fed injects reserves via overnight system RPs Weds.
newsitem.headline: Fed injects reserves via overnight system RPs Weds.

text.p: The Federal Reserve injected reserves into the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements Wednesday during its usual midmorning intervention period, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.

Fed funds opened at 5-1/2 percent and were last trading at 5-9/16 percent -- same as prior to the operation -- and well above the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/4 percent. Economists attributed the tightness to normal end-of-month pressures.
(( -- John P. Hughes, N.A. Treasury desk 212-859-1663))
